Name of Test Case: Update church display name and city in Church Setup
Action to Take: Sign in to '#/setup', change church name to 'Grace Fellowship Church', city to 'Denver, CO', and click 'Save changes'.
Expected Outcome: Calls PUT /api/church/content with updated details; updates document title and header church name.

Name of Test Case: Update church phone number and primary office email
Action to Take: Change church phone to '(555) 019-3322' and email to 'hello@gracechurch.org', and save.
Expected Outcome: Updates stored church contact facts; reflected across footer, directory, and contact blocks.

Name of Test Case: Set physical street address and weekly office hours
Action to Take: Update street address to '500 Mountain View Rd' and office hours to 'Tue-Fri 9am-3pm', and save.
Expected Outcome: Updates facility details; updates Google Maps directions links sitewide.

Name of Test Case: Add new weekly worship service time slot
Action to Take: Click '+ Add service time', select day 'Sunday', time '5:00 PM', description 'Evening Worship', and click Save.
Expected Outcome: Adds service slot to church info services array; visible on Home and Plan Your Visit service dropdowns.

Name of Test Case: Remove outdated worship service time slot
Action to Take: Click 'Remove' trash button on Wednesday 6:30 PM service slot and save.
Expected Outcome: Deletes service item from services list; removed from public site schedule.

Name of Test Case: Add new frequently asked question (FAQ) and response
Action to Take: Click '+ Add FAQ', enter question 'Is there childcare available?', enter answer 'Yes, for ages 0-5', and save.
Expected Outcome: Appends FAQ item to church faqs array; renders in accordion on Plan Your Visit page.

Name of Test Case: Create a new serving ministry team with team lead
Action to Take: Click '+ Add ministry', enter name 'Hospitality Greeters', lead 'Laura Bailey', category 'Hospitality', and save.
Expected Outcome: Calls PUT /api/church/content with new ministry item; ministry appears on Serve page.

Name of Test Case: Select partner mission countries for Prayer Map display
Action to Take: Check partner countries 'Brazil', 'Japan', and 'Uganda' in the mission regions multi-select list and save.
Expected Outcome: Updates supported country codes; Prayer Map highlights selected countries with border overlays.

Name of Test Case: Enforce sign-in prompt when unauthenticated user accesses setup
Expected Outcome: Setup forms are hidden; displays StaffSignIn form with email and password inputs.

Name of Test Case: Concurrent setup updates overwritten without conflict resolution
Action to Take: Two staff administrators edit church service times simultaneously from separate laptops.
Expected Outcome: System detects concurrent modification and flags conflict.
